title: Unit price history
description: Read-only pricing preview from fictional demo inventory
searchHint: Results include only units you can currently access.
baselineInfo: This is the unit's current fictional demo price, not an approved price-version record.
none: No approved price changes are recorded.
noDate: Original listing date is not known.
noSelection: Choose a unit to see its price baseline.
noneFound: No accessible units match this search.
changesBlocked: Price edits and approvals are planned for the separate E.3 pricing gate. No financial records are created here.
unknown: This unit is not available in your current scope.
previewIntro: Simulate a fictional unit payment plan. Nothing is saved, approved, invoiced or paid.
previewShareError: Every share must be 0–100% with at most two decimals, and the shares must total exactly 100%.
previewStatus: Unapproved preview — no due dates, booking or settlement
previewMoneyWarning: No quotation, accounting journal, invoice, payment request, bank instruction or settlement is created.
previewNoAuthority: Pricing preview requires a separately granted pricing permission.
previewFailed: Could not calculate the plan. Nothing was saved.
previewHelp: The last instalment receives the rounding remainder to the paisa. Construction milestones have no assumed dates.
templateIntro: Project-private draft templates and immutable revisions. No plan is approved or published.
templateSelect: Choose a draft to inspect or revise
templateError: Could not save draft. No partial version was created.
templateEmpty: No draft templates match this search.
templateNoHistory: Select a template to inspect the immutable revision history.
templatePrivate: Visible only to its creator in this project
templateNotApproved: Draft only — never effective for a quotation, booking or invoice
templateValidation: Enter a name of at least 3 characters, a project and allocation rows totaling exactly 100%.
templateTitleUnchanged: No approval, publication, price update or payment is performed.
templateConflict: This draft was changed or this request key was already used. Refresh the record before submitting again.
policyIntro: Illustrative, project-private pricing drafts. No policy is effective, approved or applied to unit prices.
policyEmpty: No accessible pricing drafts match your search.
policyNoProjects: No project is available within your current permission scope.
policySelect: Select a pricing draft to revise it.
policyError: Unable to save pricing draft. Nothing was approved or applied.
policyValidation: Provide a project, a name (3–100 characters), and 1–3 unique unit types. Rates must be valid PKR amounts; each premium must be 0–10000 basis points.
policyWarning: Draft only: rates are illustrative and do not affect listings, quotes, invoices, payments or settlements.
policyConflict: This pricing draft changed or the request key was reused. Reload it before editing again.
commercialIntro: Private illustrative draft rules. No fee, discount or tax is approved, collected or posted.
commercialWarning: Draft only: not effective for quotes, invoices, bookings, payment requests, taxes or bank settlement.
commercialHelp: Rates use whole basis points, where 10000 equals 100%. Discounts are bounded by their PKR cap. Zero-value entries remain visible.
commercialSaved: Draft saved without approval or posting.
commercialError: Save or preview failed. No financial record was posted.
commercialValidation: Provide a project, a title (3–100 characters), and at least one rule. Use unique uppercase codes, a 3–80 character description, valid PKR amounts and rates from 0 to 10000.
commercialEmpty: No accessible drafts match this search.
commercialSelect: Choose one of your drafts to revise or preview.
commercialConflict: Draft changed or request key was reused; reload before editing.
commercialNoProject: No pricing project available to this user.
commercialNoUnit: No unit in this project's current scope.
commercialPreviewOnly: Unapproved calculation — no money was transferred.
commercialPreviewError: Excessive discount or invalid draft. Preview refused without changes.
commercialUnsaved: Save your draft changes before previewing. The preview uses only the last saved revision.
approvalIntro: Configure project-private maker-checker draft requirements. No draft approves any transaction.
approvalWarning: Draft only. No rule is activated; price changes, discounts, fees and payment plans remain unapproved.
approvalNoSelf: Maker-checker separation is always required. The creator may never approve their own request.
approvalSaved: Draft saved. No approval rules were activated.
approvalError: Unable to save draft. No rule was activated.
approvalInvalid: Choose an authorized project, a 3–100 character title and unique categories. Thresholds must be valid PKR, with 1–3 distinct reviewers.
approvalEmpty: No drafts visible in your current access scope.
approvalConflict: Draft changed or request key was reused. Reload before editing again.
approvalDisclaimer: These illustrative thresholds are not adopted financial approval limits.
priceChangeIntro: Create a private proposed price draft. The listed price and approved price history will not change.
priceChangeNone: No private price change drafts recorded for this unit.
priceChangeSelect: Select a unit to view or propose a price change.
priceChangeViewHistory: View price baseline and approved history
priceChangeAccess: Price changes require a separately granted pricing permission. You can still view the listed price.
priceChangeWarning: Draft only. No price change is approved, scheduled, applied to inventory, quoted, invoiced or paid.
priceChangeValidation: Enter a valid PKR price different from the current listed price and a reason of 10–500 characters.
priceChangeSaved: Private price-change draft saved. The unit's price is unchanged.
priceChangeError: Could not save draft. No unit price was changed.
priceChangeConflict: This draft changed or its request key was reused. Refresh before editing again.
priceChangeNeverApproved: No approval or scheduling is available for this draft.
